buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of District Magistrate, Murshidabad payable at District Magistrate, Murshidabad . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS (ATC) For Transport and Storage of Food Stuff and Other Articles under Domkal I CDS Project 1. Scope of Work The contractor shall undertake loading, unloading, transportation/carrying, storage, preservation a nd delivery of food grains, food articles and other ICDS materials to all Anganwadi Centers from Pr oject Godown as directed by the concerned Child Development Project Officer (CDPO). The consi gnee's address provided in the bid document shall be disregarded. For the purpose o f transportation to all Anganwadi Centers of the project, the pickup point shall be the Project Godown. The quoted rate shall be inclusive of loading, unloading, labour, transportation, storage, handling, insurance, taxes, duties and all incidental charges unless otherwise specifically provided. Earnest money Rs. 13000/- (Thirteen thousand) only has to be deposited by the bidder. 2. Experience Criteria For qualification, the bidder shall satisfy the following: The intending Tenderers should produce credential(s) of a similar nature of completed work of car rying cumstoring of food stuff in at least one year of last five years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26) for an amount of Rs. 3,25,000/- (Rupees Three lakhs and Twenty Five thousand ) only with respect to transport/carrying & Storing under Government Department or (ii) Intending tenderers should produce credentials of 2 (two) similar nature of completed work in at least one y ear of last five years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26), and the minimum value of each work should be of Rs. 2,43,750/- (Rupees Two lakhs Forty Three thousand Seven Hundred Fif ty) only with respect to transport/carrying & Storing under Government Department. The bidder shall upload copies of Work Orders along with Completion Certificates / Performance C ertificate(s) / Work Completion Report(s) or equivalent documentary evidence establishing succes sful completion.

3. Financial Eligibility The bidder shall upload: ● Audited Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss Account for the last three financial years (2023-2 4, 2024-25, 2025-26). ● PAN Card. ● GST Registration Certificate and latest challan (at least March, 2026). ● Professional Tax Registration and latest return (at least March, 2026). ● Similar nature of Trade Licence, (Transport/carrying and Storage of food stuff). ● Income Tax Return of the last three financial years.(2023-24,2024-25, 2025-26) 4. Godown Requirements The successful bidder shall provide a pucca godown of having 300 MT storage capacity, proper ve ntilation, pest control measures, fire safety arrangements, dunnage facility and truck-accessible a pproach road. The godown shall be capable of storing approximately the quantity specified in the bid in a safe an d hygienic condition. The bidder shall submit: ● Ownership document or valid rent agreement. ● Sketch map showing location duly signed by the appropriate authority. ● Dag No., Khatian No. and area details with Latitude and Longitude (4 decimal). ● Coloured photographs of the proposed godown. ● Within 5 km from the CDPO office having truckable Pucca roadside storing facility 5. Delivery The contractor shall complete transportation and delivery within the period specified by the concerned CDPO. Digital weighing machines shall be used wherever required. Delivery challans shall be prepared for every consignment and acknowledged by the receiving aut hority. 6. Safety of Stock The contractor shall remain fully responsible for any loss, theft, pilferage, deterioration, moisture d amage, rodent damage or other loss occurring while the stock remains in his custody. The godown should be locked under double lock system so that first key must remain with the store keeper of t he respective Project and the second shall remain with the storing agent. 7. Records The contractor shall maintain: ● Stock Register ● Delivery Register ● Receipt Register ● Vehicle Movement Register ● Acknowledgement Records The records shall be produced for inspection whenever required by the Procuring Entity. 8. Statutory Compliance The contractor shall comply with all applicable provisions of: ● General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017. ● West Bengal Financial Rules.

● Relevant Government of West Bengal Finance Department Orders. ● Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) Guidelines, wherever applicable. ● GeM General Terms & Conditions. ● Labour laws, GST laws and other statutory provisions. 9. Integrity Declaration The bidder shall certify that: ● It has not been debarred or blacklisted by any Government Department, PSU, Autonomous Body or Local Authority as on the last date of submission of bid; ● It has not been convicted for offences involving fraud, corruption, bribery, collusive biddin g or moral turpitude. ● All information furnished in the bid is true and correct. Submission of false information shall lead to rejection of the bid and such other action as permissi ble under law. 10. Clarification of Documents The competent authority may seek clarification or verification of documents submitted by the bidd er wherever considered necessary. Failure to furnish satisfactory clarification within the stipulated period may render the bid liable for rejection. 11. Evaluation Only substantially responsive bids fulfilling the published eligibility and qualification criteria shall b e considered for financial evaluation. The quoted rate per metric tonne (MT) for transport and storage, taken together, shall be considered for bid evaluation. Under no circums tances shall separate rates quoted for storing and carrying be considered for evaluati on. 12. Abnormally Low Bid Where the quoted rate appears to be abnormally low, the Tender Evaluation Committee may seek written justification from the bidder. If the explanation is found unsatisfactory, the bid may be reje cted for recording reasons. 13. Performance Security The successful bidder shall furnish Performance Security Rs. 19,500/- (Rupees Nineteen thousand and Five hundred) only as prescribed in the bid document before execution of the agreement. 14. Contract Period The contract shall remain valid for one year from the date of execution of the agreement and may be extended in accordance with Government orders and the terms of the contract based on satisf actory performance. 15. Right of the Procuring Entity The Authority reserves the right to accept or reject any or all bids or cancel the bidding process at any stage without assigning any reason, subject to the applicable procurement rules. 16. Jurisdiction Any dispute arising out of this contract shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the competent courts in the State of West Bengal.

Declaration regarding fire safety arrangements. 7. Declaration regarding pest control and rodent-free condition. 8. Declaration regarding dunnage and damp-proof arrangements. E. Declarations & Undertakings (must be uploaded at the folder “Certificate ”)

1. Bidder's Undertaking regarding correctness of information. 2. Declaration regarding Non-Blacklisting / Non-Debarment. 3. Declaration regarding Non-Conviction. 4. Acceptance of all Bid Terms & Conditions. Notes: 1. Original documents shall be produced for verification whenever demanded by t he Authority. 2. Bidders shall upload all required documents strictly in accordance with the provi sions of this ATC (noted in the points A, B, C, D, E of ANNEXURE A). Non-complia nce with these requirements may lead to the rejection or cancellation of the bid. All documents submitted by the bidder shall be serially marked and in dexed on the upper-left-hand corner of each document in accordance w ith Annexure-A. For example, Declaration regarding Non-Conviction sh all be marked as “E-3”, as specified in Annexure-A. 3. Payment for the transportation and storage services shall be made only upon th e availability of funds and in accordance with the applicable Government rules and procedures. 4. In the event of any conflict, inconsistency, or contradiction between the provisio ns of this Bid Document and the GeM Additional Terms and Conditions (ATC), th e provisions of the ATC shall prevail and shall be binding. All other terms and co nditions of the Bid Document, to the extent they are not inconsistent with the A TC, shall remain unchanged and continue to be in full force and effect. 5. The bids/offers submitted in hard copy/ fax/ E-mail etc. shall NOT be considered /shall be treated as non-responsive. No correspondence will be entertained on t his matter. 6. The Procuring Entity reserves the right to verify experience, past performance a nd financial credentials from the issuing authority. 7. Submission of false, forged or misleading information shall render the bid liable for rejection and may invite further action under the applicable procurement rul es. .
